text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second senior year obstacle is the G1 spring Tenno Sho. If Kitasan Black performs well here, then she's guaranteed to go down in history as a force to be reckoned with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her determination makes Brusquement and Air Groove take notice of her.
